DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の予約をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Gusto po bang mag-book ng konsultasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の相談です。日本語が苦手なので、私の名前で予約して二人で来ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の相談を自分名義で予約できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Para po sa kaibigan. Mahina siya sa Japanese; maaari bang sa pangalan ko at dalawa kaming pumunta?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maibubook sa sariling pangalan ang konsultasyon ng kaibigan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談するご本人のお名前と、付き添う方の役割を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay nating titiyakin ang pangalan ng kukonsulta at role ng kasama.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の相談として登録するのは違いますね。本人の了解を得て予約を手伝っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の同意を得た予約補助だと役割を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala sariling konsultasyon ang ipaparehistro. May pahintulot niya akong tumulong sa booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama ang role bilang booking assistant na may pahintulot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 希望する相談内容の大まかな分野と、言語を教えてください。通訳の対応は確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sabihin ang pangkalahatang paksa at wika. Kailangang tiyakin ang interpreter.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住居についての相談で、本人はベトナム語を希望しています。私が来られる日は限られるので、通訳の可否も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談分野と言語希望を伝え通訳の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tungkol po sa tirahan at Vietnamese ang gusto niya. Limitado ang araw ko kaya gusto kong malaman ang interpreter availability.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang paksa at wika at itanong ang interpreter. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。あなたが説明を代わりに決めるのでなく、本人の希望を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itatanong sa staff. Matitiyak ba ang gusto niya sa halip na kayo ang magtakda ng paliwanag?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の空いている日だけで予約を決めず、本人に候補日と通訳の確認状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の希望日を確認してから選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Hindi ko sariling bakante lang ang batayan; ipapaalam sa kanya ang mga petsa at status ng interpreter.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing pipili matapos tiyakin ang gustong araw ng mismong tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約が成立するには、その返事と窓口側の確認が必要です。今は希望の受付として記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kailangan ang sagot at office confirmation para matuloy. Kahilingan pa lang ang itatala ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。予約確定とは伝えず、本人の名前と希望を確認してから返事します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確定と理解し本人情報確認後に返答すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hindi ko sasabihing kumpirmado; sasagot matapos matiyak ang pangalan at gusto niya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Unawaing hindi pa tiyak at sabihing sasagot matapos tiyakin ang impormasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、連絡方法をご案内します。付き添いの有無も返事の際にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ituturo ang contact. Sabihin din sa sagot kung may kasama.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 注文メモの内容をご確認いただけますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: えびを取り消したはずですが、まだ書かれています。えびを避ける必要があるので、調理前か確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 避ける料理がメモに残り調理前か確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kinansela ko po sana ang hipon pero nakasulat pa. Kailangan kong umiwas dito; pakitiyak kung hindi pa niluluto.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nananatili ang bawal na pagkain sa memo at ipasuri kung hindi pa niluluto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 調理の進行と取り消しの伝達状況を担当に確認します。ほかの料理も含めて確認が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Itatanong ang cooking progress at cancellation message. Kailangan bang tingnan pati iba?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。野菜なら問題ないと自分で判断せず、油や調理器具についても説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 野菜も油や器具を含め説明が必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo. Hindi ko sariling masasabing ayos ang gulay; gusto ko ring malaman ang mantika at kagamitan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing kailangan ng paliwanag pati mantika at kagamitan ng gulay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。材料だけでなく調理条件も担当に伝えます。ここで対応を保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sige po. Sangkap at cooking conditions ang ipapasa. Hindi namin magagarantiya rito ang tugon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 説明まで、私の注文全体を進めないよう担当に伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明まで自分の注文全体を止めるよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakisabi po na huwag ituloy ang buong order ko hangga't walang paliwanag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling na ihinto ang buong sariling order hanggang paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 伝えます。ご同行の方の注文と区別するため、どちらがあなたの分か確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sasabihin. Tiyakin kung alin ang sa inyo upang maihiwalay sa kasama.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この野菜と、取り消しをお願いしたえびが私の分です。隣の方の注文は私が変更するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分と同行者の注文範囲を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itong gulay at kinanselang hipon po ang akin. Hindi ako ang magpapabago ng sa katabi.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang sariling order at kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が状態を確認して来ます。注文メモだけで取り消し完了と扱わずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Babalik ang staff matapos tingnan. Huwag isiping tapos ang cancellation batay sa memo lamang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。調理の状態と対応範囲を聞き、自分の分をどうするか決めます。取り消しが伝わったかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実際の状態と伝達を確認してから注文を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Pakikinggan ang kalagayan at kayang gawin bago magpasya sa akin. Titiyakin din na naiparating ang cancellation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasya matapos tiyakin ang aktuwal at mensahe. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。あなたの分を区別して担当へ報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Hiwalay na iuulat ang sa inyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 費用表で分かりにくい項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: May hindi po malinaw sa cost table?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃と管理費に鍵交換の欄も足しました。毎月この合計を払うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一回の鍵交換費を月額に含めた計算を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pinagsama ko po ang renta, management fee at key replacement. Ito ba lahat buwan-buwan?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pagkasama ng one-time key fee sa monthly. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この見積りでは、鍵交換は入居時の一回の費用として示しています。月額の欄とは分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa estimate na ito, isang beses sa paglipat ang key replacement. Hiwalay sa buwanang field.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一回の費用を毎月の支払いへ混ぜていました。月額合計と入居時合計を別に示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 月額と入居時の合計を分けて提示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nahalo ko po ang minsanan sa monthly. Maaari bang hiwalay ipakita ang monthly total at move-in total?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hilinging hiwalay ang monthly at move-in totals. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つに分けて説明します。ただし、これは見積りで、契約条件の確認はまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hiwalay ipapaliwanag pero estimate lamang; hindi pa kumpirmado ang kontrata.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この金額で契約が確定したとは扱いません。更新時の費用は今の二つの合計に含まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見積り未確定と認め更新費の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po ituturing na tiyak ang kontrata sa halagang ito. Kasama ba sa dalawang total ang renewal fee?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Kilalaning estimate pa at itanong ang renewal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 更新については別の条件欄です。期間と金額の記載を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ibang conditions field ang renewal. Tingnan ang panahon at halaga.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 毎月、入居時、更新時の三つに分けてメモします。口頭の説明と書面で違うところがあれば聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三つの支払時期で整理し書面と照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Monthly, move-in at renewal po ang tatlong memo. Kung iba ang salita at sulat, itatanong muli.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ayusin sa tatlong payment times at ihambing sa sulat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今日は契約を進めるか、説明を持ち帰るか、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Itutuloy ang kontrata ngayon o iuuwi ang paliwanag?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見積りと条件の説明を持ち帰り、三つの時期ごとに予算を確認します。今日は申込みを確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を持ち帰り予算確認前は申込みを確定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Iuuwi po ang estimate at kondisyon at titingnan ang budget sa tatlong panahon. Hindi muna kukumpirmahin ang application ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iuwi ang materyal at huwag mag-apply nang pinal bago budget check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認する項目を記した資料をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Ibibigay ang materyal na may kailangang tingnan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約された機器をご利用ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。初めてなので、予約の時間に指導員が使い方を教えてくれると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 機器予約に指導が含まれると思ったことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Una ko kaya akala ko may instructor sa reserved time na magtuturo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang kasama ang instruction sa equipment booking. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その枠は機器の利用予約です。指導員の説明予約とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Equipment use reservation ang slot, hiwalay sa instructor explanation booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 説明が付いている枠ではなかったのですね。操作が分からないので、今は機器を動かしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 操作不明なので起動しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala kasamang paliwanag. Hindi ko alam ang operasyon kaya hindi muna paandarin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi paandarin dahil hindi alam ang operasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 初回案内を受ける方法を確認します。これまでの利用経験はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang first-use guidance. May dating karanasan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の機器は使いましたが、この機器はありません。似ているから同じ操作だとは考えず教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当該機器は未経験と申告し説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Iba pong kagamitan, pero hindi ito. Hindi ko iisiping pareho dahil kahawig; pakituro.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang karanasan dito at humiling ng gabay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明担当が案内できる時刻を確認します。予約時間を待つだけで説明が来るとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang available na instructor. Hindi basta darating ang paliwanag sa paghihintay sa slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では利用枠の扱いも聞きたいです。案内を受ける前に時間だけ延ばすのではなく、予約窓口で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明前の利用枠の扱いを窓口に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto ko rin pong itanong ang use reservation. Hindi oras lang pahahabain bago matuto; sa booking counter ako kukonsulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong sa counter ang use slot bago instruction. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から説明と予約の両方を案内します。体調など、利用前に伝えることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabay ituturo ang explanation at booking. May kalagayan bang kailangang sabihin bago gumamit?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は特に申告したい変化はありませんが、利用条件も説明で確認します。案内後に使うか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用条件を確認してから使用を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Wala pong partikular na bagong pagbabago ngayon pero titiyakin rin ang use conditions. Pagkatapos ng gabay ako magpapasya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang conditions bago magpasya sa paggamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では機器から離れた待機場所へどうぞ。説明ができる担当を呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sa hintayan na malayo sa kagamitan muna. Tatawagin ang makapagtuturo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車券の画面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Maaari pong makita ang ticket screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この画面です。今朝、出発便を変更しましたが、スクリーンショットならすぐ見せられると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 便変更後に古いスクリーンショットを提示したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ito po. Binago ko ang departure trip kaninang umaga pero akala ko madali kong maipapakita ang screenshot.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang lumang screenshot matapos baguhin ang biyahe. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは変更前の便です。変更後の乗車券を開けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bago ang pagbabago itong biyahe. Mabubuksan ang bagong tiket?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い画面を出していました。購入サイトに入り、変更後の便が反映されているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入サイトで変更後の券を開き確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Luma po ang naipakita. Papasok ako sa purchase site at titingnan kung reflected ang bago.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Buksan sa purchase site ang binagong tiket at tiyakin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この画面が変更後ですね。出発時刻と乗り場を案内表示で照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito na ang bago. Itugma ang oras at stop sa display.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 便は確認できました。座席も前の十二番のままだと思っていましたが、今は十八番と表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 便だけでなく新しい座席番号も読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Natiyak ang biyahe. Akala ko 12 pa rin ang seat pero 18 na po ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Basahin muli pati ang bagong seat number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗車時は現在の券の案内に従ってください。古い便の列には並ばないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa pagsakay sundin ang kasalukuyang ticket. Huwag pumila sa dating biyahe.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い列へは戻りません。同行者には以前の座席で探さないよう、今の便と十八番を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い列を避け同行者へ便と座席の変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi po babalik sa luma. Sasabihin sa kasama ang bagong biyahe at 18 upang hindi ako hanapin sa dati.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iwasan ang lumang pila at ipaalam ang bagong trip at seat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。乗り場の案内が変更された場合は、当日の表示や係員に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Kung magbago ang stop, tingnan ang display o staff ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更後の券を開いたまま、当日の乗り場を確認します。古い画像は今回の提示に使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日の乗り場を確認し現在の券だけ提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Bukas po ang bagong tiket habang tinitiyak ang stop ngayon. Hindi ko gagamitin ang lumang image.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang stop ngayon at kasalukuyang ticket lamang ang ipakita. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、その便の案内に従ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Kapag handa na, sundin ang gabay ng biyaheng iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この欄に、送金の目的を記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Isulat dito ang purpose ng remittance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手の口座番号を書きました。送金先の情報を聞かれたと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目的欄に口座番号を書いた誤りを申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Account number po ng tatanggap ang naisulat. Akala ko destination information ang tanong.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang maling account number sa purpose field. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座情報は別の欄です。ここでは、何の支払いかを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ibang field ang account. Dito, anong bayad ang tinitiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学費の支払いです。目的欄にある番号はその説明ではないので、修正方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学費目的を述べ訂正方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tuition po. Hindi paliwanag ang numerong ito; pakituro ang correction.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang tuition purpose at itanong ang correction. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訂正方法は担当がご案内します。学費の案内や請求書はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang magtuturo. May tuition guide o invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求書を持っています。送金額には授業料以外の寮費もあるので、学費だけと書いてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 授業料と寮費の内訳を示し目的表現を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: May invoice po. Kasama ang dorm fee bukod sa tuition kaya gusto kong tiyaking sapat ang tuition lang na sulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang tuition at dorm breakdown at itanong ang purpose wording. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内訳を担当へ見せてください。目的や必要書類を、この窓口で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipakita ang breakdown. Dito titiyakin ang layunin at dokumento.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では授業料と寮費の二つを示します。審査が済んだことにはせず、提出前に説明を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二つの目的を説明し未確認で提出しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pareho pong tuition at dorm ang ipapakita. Hindi pa ituturing na tapos ang screening; paliwanag muna bago isumite.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang dalawang purpose at huwag isumite nang hindi pa tiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取人の情報についても、別の欄で確認します。目的欄の数字を移せば完了とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay na titiyakin ang recipient. Hindi awtomatikong tapos sa paglipat lang ng numero.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。番号も請求書と照合し直し、目的と受取人情報を別々に確認してから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目的と口座情報を別に照合してから提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Itutugma muli ang number sa invoice at hiwalay titiyakin ang layunin at recipient bago isumite.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hiwalay na ihambing ang purpose at account information bago isumite. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。修正前の用紙もそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Iuugnay sa staff. Dalhin nang ganoon ang hindi pa naitama.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品についてご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 白く盛り上がった所があります。展示中に汚れたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原画の白い跡を展示汚れか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: May puting nakaumbok. Nadumihan po ba habang naka-display?
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung dumi sa exhibit ang puting bakas sa orihinal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原画の制作過程に関係する跡の場合があります。作品の解説を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaaring bakas ng paggawa ng orihinal. Tingnan ang paliwanag.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙の損傷と決めていました。触って確かめず、解説でこの部分を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 損傷断定と接触を避け解説を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Inakala ko pong sira ang papel. Hindi hahawakan para tiyakin; gusto kong malaman sa paliwanag.
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Iwasan ang tiyak na sira at paghawak at humiling ng paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この解説では描き直した部分と案内しています。

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 印刷された本で見えなかった理由も知りたいです。原画と完成した印刷ページを比べられますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原画と印刷ページの比較先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto ko ring malaman kung bakit hindi kita sa printed book. May paghahambingan ba ng original at final page?
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang comparison ng original at printed page. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 比較用の展示は向こうです。撮影条件は別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Nandoon ang comparison display. Hiwalay tingnan ang photo conditions.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展示の理解のために比較します。違いを見つけても印刷ミスと決めず、制作の説明を読みます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見た差を印刷ミスと断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Para po maintindihan ang exhibit ang paghahambing. Hindi ko sasabihing print error ang pagkakaiba; babasahin ang proseso.
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag ituring na print error ang nakitang pagkakaiba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない所があれば、作品名を示して聞いてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kung hindi malinaw, itanong gamit ang artwork name.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。原画の修正跡と印刷後の見え方を分けてメモし、撮影するなら先に条件を聞きます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 制作跡と印刷を分け記録し撮影条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hiwalay kong itatala ang correction marks at printed result; kung kukuha, hihingi muna ng kondisyon.
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hiwalay itala ang creation marks at print at tiyakin ang photo rules. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では比較展示へどうぞ。原画には触れずご覧ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MITAKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sa comparison exhibit po. Huwag hawakan ang orihinal.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 表示のことでお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa sign ang tanong?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 対象年齢より小さい子ですが、私が大人なので一緒なら使えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大人同伴なら年齢条件を満たすと思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mas bata po sa target age pero adulto ako kaya akala ko puwede kapag kasama ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang natutupad ang age requirement sa kasamang adulto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示は利用する子の条件です。大人の年齢に置き換えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Edad ng batang gagamit ang kondisyon. Huwag palitan ng edad ng adulto.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 付き添う人の年齢ではなかったのですね。まだ乗せていません。子の年齢に合う場所を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用と伝え子の条件に合う場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala edad ng kasama. Hindi ko pa pinasakay; pakituro ang lugar na angkop sa bata.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa ginamit at itanong ang angkop sa bata. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の遊び場の案内を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maaaring tingnan ang ibang playground guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ形の遊具なら条件も同じとは考えず、そちらでも表示を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 形の類似と条件一致を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping pareho ang kondisyon dahil parehong hugis; babasahin din doon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang kahawig na hugis at kaparehong kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現地の案内と状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan ang lokal na guide at kalagayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。子だけ先に走らせず、一緒に移動して使える範囲を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子と一緒に移動して表示確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Hindi ko pauunahin ang bata tumakbo; sabay kaming lilipat at titiyakin ang saklaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sumama sa bata at tingnan ang sign. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図はこちらです。使えない遊具へ持ち上げて乗せる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ito ang mapa. Hindi kailangang buhatin sa kagamitang hindi puwede.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち上げて使わせることはしません。子の条件に合う遊び場を確認してから遊びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち上げて対象外遊具を使わせず適合を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi ko po bubuhatin para gamitin. Titiyakin ang angkop na lugar bago maglaro.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag buhatin sa hindi sakop na kagamitan at tiyakin ang kaangkupan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では案内された場所で表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tingnan ang sign sa itinurong lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 裏が滑り止めなので、壁へ貼って小物を置けると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 滑り止めを壁用接着と考えた用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: May non-slip sa likod kaya akala ko maikakabit sa pader para patungan ng maliliit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang gamit na inakalang wall adhesive ang non-slip. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 滑り止めと接着面は別です。用途の表示を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang non-slip at adhesive. Tingnan ang use label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 壁用の棚になる物ではないのですね。まだ買わず、平らな所へ敷く用途を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚になる誤解を直し敷く用途を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala magiging wall shelf. Hindi muna bibili; titiyakin ang paglatag sa patag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama ang shelf misunderstanding at tiyakin ang mat use. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品は置き場所の条件も表示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: May location conditions din sa label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚の上に敷きたいですが、棚の材質が分かりません。相性を自分で決めず家で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 棚材質未確認を述べ適合を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa shelf ko sana ilalatag pero hindi ko alam ang materyal. Hindi ko huhulaan ang tugma; titingnan sa bahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi tiyak ang shelf material at suriin ang compatibility. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品名と注意書きを控えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaaring itala ang pangalan at babala.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えます。大きい品を載せるから二枚を貼り合わせようとも思いましたが、その使い方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注意を控え貼合せ自己加工をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itatala ko po. Naisip ko ring pagdikitin ang dalawa dahil malaking gamit ang ipapatong pero hindi ko gagawin iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itala ang babala at huwag sariling pagdikitin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 寸法と用途を確認してから選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pumili matapos tiyakin ang sukat at gamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。家の棚を確認し、表示の範囲で使えると分かってから購入します。今日は持ち帰りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家庭の条件確認まで購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Susuriin ang shelf sa bahay at bibili kapag alam na sakop ng label. Hindi ko iuuwi ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang pagbili hanggang tiyak ang bahay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では商品はこちらで戻します。表示を控えてご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ibabalik namin ang produkto. Itala ang label at pag-isipan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ano po ang pangalan ng reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 午前に焼き上がりの時間を聞きました。聞いた時点で一つ残してもらえると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 焼上り時刻を聞くだけで取置きと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tinanong ko po kaninang umaga ang oras ng pagkaluto. Akala ko sa pagtatanong ay itatabi na ang isa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pag-aakalang oras na tanong lamang ay reservation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時間の案内と取置きの受付は別です。お名前や数量を申し込まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang time information at reservation. Nag-apply ng pangalan at dami?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 申し込んでいません。時間だけ聞いたので、予約済みとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前数量未申込と認め予約と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po. Oras lang kaya hindi masasabing reserved na.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Amining wala pang pangalan at dami at ihiwalay sa booking. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の在庫を確認します。ご希望は一つですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ang stock. Isa po ang gusto?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、一つです。売切れなら、誰かの予約分を回してほしいとは頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望数を伝え他人の予約分を要求しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo, isa. Kung ubos, hindi ko hihilingin ang reservation ng iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang isa at huwag hilingin ang sa ibang tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は一つ販売できます。今後の取置き条件も聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: May isang mabebenta ngayon. Maaari ring itanong ang future reservation conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はその一つを買います。次回は時間を聞くだけでなく、取置き可否と申込方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現販売品を買い次回の取置き方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ito po ang bibilhin. Sa susunod, hindi oras lang; gusto kong malaman kung puwedeng ireserba at paano.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Bilhin ang kasalukuyan at itanong ang susunod na reservation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次回の受付方法をご案内します。今日の分はこの商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ituturo ang susunod. Ito ang produkto ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日の一つを確認して払い、次回は受付確認ができてから予約済みと考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日購入と次回受付確認を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat po. Titiyakin at babayaran ang isa ngayon. Sa susunod, ituturing na reserved kapag natiyak ang pagtanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pagbili ngayon at reservation confirmation sa susunod. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにご確認ください。本日分をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganoon ang tiyakin. Ibibigay ang para ngayon.
